quadriceps__example.text: Press through your front foot and feel the front of your thigh working.

lengthen__example.text: Lengthen through the crown of your head.

stack__example.text: Stack your knee over your ankle.

release__example.text: Release your head and let it hang heavy.

gaze__example.text: Gaze softly over your front fingertips.

tuck__example.text: Tuck your toes and lift your hips.

find-your-edge__example.text: Find your edge: enough to feel it, not so much that you tense against it.

toward__example.text: Reach your heels toward the floor.

away-from__example.text: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.

in-line-with__example.text: Keep your front heel in line with the arch of your back foot.

chaturanga__cue-1.text: Exhale, step or jump back, and lower halfway down.

chaturanga__cue-9.text: Inhale, roll over your toes into Upward Dog.

upward-dog__cue-1.text: Inhale, roll over your toes and lift your chest forward and up.

upward-dog__cue-9.text: Exhale, roll back over your toes into Downward Dog.

downward-dog__cue-1.text: Exhale, roll over your toes and lift your hips up and back.

downward-dog__cue-9.text: At the end of your exhale, bend your knees and look between your hands.

chair-pose__cue-1.text: Inhale, bend your knees and reach your arms up.

chair-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, fold forward and place your hands beside your feet.

warrior-1__cue-1.text: Turn your back heel down and step your right foot forward between your hands.

warrior-1__cue-9.text: Inhale, straighten your front leg and turn to the other side.

big-toe-pose__cue-1.text: Step or jump your feet hip-width apart, parallel.

big-toe-pose__cue-2.text: Fold and hook your big toes with your first two fingers.

big-toe-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, lift your head and straighten your arms.

hand-under-foot-pose__cue-1.text: Lift the front of your feet and slide your hands underneath, palms up.

hand-under-foot-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, look up. Exhale, hands to your hips. Inhale, come all the way up.

triangle__cue-1.text: Step your feet about a leg’s length apart and turn your right toes out.

triangle__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up, and turn to the left.

revolved-triangle__cue-1.text: Turn your right toes out and your back foot in, and square your hips forward.

revolved-triangle__cue-2.text: Exhale, fold over your front leg and bring your left hand outside your right foot.

extended-side-angle__cue-1.text: Step your feet wide and turn your right toes out.

revolved-side-angle__cue-1.text: Turn to the right, turn your back foot in, and bend your front knee.

revolved-side-angle__cue-2.text: Exhale, twist and bring your left shoulder outside your right knee.

wide-legged-fold__cue-1.text: Step your feet wide apart, toes turned slightly in.

wide-legged-fold__cue-2.text: Exhale, place your hands on the floor between your feet, shoulder-width apart.

wide-legged-fold__cue-9.text: Inhale, look up. Exhale, hands to your waist. Inhale, come all the way up.

pyramid-pose__cue-1.text: Bring your palms together behind your back, fingers pointing up.

pyramid-pose__cue-2.text: Turn to the right: front toes forward, back foot turned in.

standing-hand-to-toe__cue-1.text: Shift your weight onto your left foot, and catch your right big toe with your first two fingers.

standing-hand-to-toe__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your leg, and come back to Samasthiti.

half-bound-lotus-standing__cue-1.text: Lift your right foot into half lotus, high on your left thigh.

half-bound-lotus-standing__cue-3.text: Exhale, fold forward and place your left hand beside your left foot.

half-bound-lotus-standing__cue-9.text: Inhale, look up. Then come up slowly and release your foot.

staff-pose__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, jump or step your feet through your hands and sit down.

staff-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale here, and as you exhale, reach forward for your toes.

seated-forward-fold__cue-1.text: Wrap your first two fingers around your big toes. Inhale, and lift your chest.

seated-forward-fold__cue-9.text: After the last round, inhale and look up, then lift up and jump back.

upward-plank__cue-1.text: Place your hands a little behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.

upward-plank__cue-2.text: Inhale, press into your hands and feet, and lift your hips high.

upward-plank__cue-9.text: Exhale, and lower your hips slowly to the floor.

half-bound-lotus-forward-fold__cue-1.text: Bend your right knee and place your right foot high on your left thigh, in half lotus.

half-bound-lotus-forward-fold__cue-3.text: Wrap your right arm behind your back and catch your right big toe.

half-bound-lotus-forward-fold__cue-9.text: Inhale, look up, then release your leg and take a vinyasa before the other side.

three-limb-forward-fold__cue-1.text: Fold your right leg back, with your right foot beside your right hip.

three-limb-forward-fold__cue-9.text: Inhale, lift your head, then release your leg and jump back.

janu-sirsasana__cue-1.text: Bend your right knee out to the side and place your right foot against your inner left thigh.

janu-sirsasana__cue-9.text: Inhale, look up, then release your leg and change sides.

marichyasana__cue-1.text: Bend your right knee and place your right foot close to your right sitting bone.

marichyasana__cue-3.text: Reach your right arm forward, inside your right knee, then wrap it around your shin.

marichyasana__cue-9.text: Inhale, look up, release your hands, and take a vinyasa before the other side.

boat-pose__cue-1.text: Sit with your knees bent, and lean back a little behind your sitting bones.

boat-pose__cue-2.text: Inhale, lift your feet and straighten your legs.

boat-pose__cue-9.text: Cross your legs, press your hands down, and lift up. Then sit down for the next round.

shoulder-pressing-pose__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, jump your feet around the outside of your hands.

shoulder-pressing-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, lift up and straighten your legs, then move through Crow and jump back.

tortoise-pose__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, jump your feet around your arms and sit down, knees bent.

tortoise-pose__cue-9.text: For Sleeping Tortoise, bend your knees, bind your hands behind your back, and cross your feet.

embryo-pose__cue-1.text: Come into full lotus, right foot first.

embryo-pose__cue-9.text: Round your back and roll nine times, turning in a circle, then come up into Rooster.

rooster-pose__cue-1.text: On your last roll, come forward and press your palms into the floor.

rooster-pose__cue-8.text: Exhale, lower down, release your arms and your lotus, and take a vinyasa.

bound-angle__cue-1.text: Bring the soles of your feet together and draw your heels in toward you.

bound-angle__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up to sit, and take a vinyasa.

wide-angle-seated-fold__cue-1.text: Open your legs wide and take hold of the outer edges of your feet.

wide-angle-seated-fold__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your legs, and take a vinyasa.

reclined-angle-pose__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, then exhale and roll your legs over your head.

reclined-angle-pose__cue-8.text: Inhale, roll up and balance, then exhale and land softly on your calves.

reclined-hand-to-toe__cue-1.text: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your feet together.

reclined-hand-to-toe__cue-2.text: Inhale, lift your right leg and wrap your first two fingers around your big toe.

reclined-hand-to-toe__cue-9.text: Inhale, lower your head; exhale, open your right leg out to the right and gaze over your left shoulder.

both-big-toes-pose__cue-1.text: Lie down, exhale, and roll your legs over your head, feet together.

both-big-toes-pose__cue-3.text: Inhale, roll up and balance on your sitting bones, legs straight.

both-big-toes-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, release your feet, and take a vinyasa.

upward-facing-forward-fold__cue-1.text: Lie down, exhale, and roll your legs over your head.

upward-facing-forward-fold__cue-3.text: Inhale, roll up and balance on your sitting bones.

upward-facing-forward-fold__cue-9.text: Exhale, release your feet and lower down, then take a vinyasa.

setu-bandhasana__cue-1.text: Lie on your back with your heels together, toes turned out, and knees bent open.

setu-bandhasana__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your hips slowly, then lift your head and lie down.

wheel-pose__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, bend your knees, and bring your feet hip-width apart, close to your hips.

wheel-pose__cue-2.text: Place your hands beside your ears, fingers pointing toward your shoulders.

wheel-pose__cue-3.text: Inhale, press into your hands and feet, and lift all the way up.

wheel-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, tuck your chin, and lower slowly: shoulders first, then your hips.

shoulderstand__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, and on an inhale, lift your legs and hips up over your head.

shoulderstand__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your feet over your head to the floor behind you.

plow-pose__cue-1.text: Exhale, lower your feet to the floor behind your head.

plow-pose__cue-8.text: Exhale, bend your knees down beside your ears.

ear-pressure-pose__cue-1.text: From Plow, exhale and bend your knees down beside your ears.

ear-pressure-pose__cue-8.text: Inhale, bring your hands to your back and lift your legs back up.

lotus-in-shoulderstand__cue-1.text: From Shoulderstand, fold your right leg, then your left, into lotus.

lotus-in-shoulderstand__cue-4.text: Exhale, lower your knees toward your head, and wrap your arms around your legs.

lotus-in-shoulderstand__cue-9.text: Bring your hands to the floor and roll down slowly, keeping your lotus.

fish-pose__cue-1.text: Roll down onto your back, keeping your legs in lotus.

fish-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, release your lotus, and lift your legs up straight.

extended-leg-pose__cue-1.text: Keep the arch in your back, and release your legs from lotus.

extended-leg-pose__cue-8.text: Exhale, lower your legs, then roll back over into Chaturanga.

headstand__cue-1.text: Kneel, interlace your fingers, and place your forearms on the floor, elbows shoulder-width apart.

headstand__cue-4.text: Walk your feet in, and on an inhale, lift both legs slowly.

headstand__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your legs slowly, and rest in Child’s Pose.

bound-lotus__cue-1.text: Sit in full lotus, right foot first, then left.

bound-lotus__cue-5.text: Exhale, fold forward and bring your forehead or chin toward the floor.

bound-lotus__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up, and release your hands to your knees.

lotus__cue-1.text: Bring your right foot onto your left thigh, then your left foot onto your right thigh.

lotus__cue-9.text: Place your hands beside your hips, ready to lift up.

uplifting-pose__cue-1.text: Keep your lotus, and place your palms flat beside your hips.

uplifting-pose__cue-2.text: Inhale, press your hands down and lift your hips and knees off the floor.

uplifting-pose__cue-8.text: Exhale, swing back through your arms, and land in Chaturanga.

savasana__cue-1.text: Lie down on your back, and let your legs fall open.

savasana__cue-8.text: When you’re ready, deepen your breath, roll onto your right side, and slowly come up to sit.

child-pose__cue-1.text: Bring your big toes together, and sit back toward your heels.

child-pose__cue-9.text: When you’re ready, walk your hands back and slowly sit up.

cat-pose__cue-1.text: Come onto all fours, wrists under your shoulders, knees under your hips.

cat-pose__cue-8.text: Inhale, and come back to a flat back.

cow-pose__cue-1.text: Start on all fours, with your spine long and neutral.

cow-pose__cue-8.text: Exhale, and return to a neutral spine.

puppy-pose__cue-1.text: From all fours, keep your hips over your knees, and walk your hands forward.

puppy-pose__cue-9.text: Walk your hands back, and rest in Child’s Pose.

plank__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, inhale and shift forward, shoulders over your wrists.

plank__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower halfway down to Chaturanga, or lift your hips back to Downward Dog.

forearm-plank__cue-1.text: From all fours, lower onto your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.

forearm-plank__cue-2.text: Step your feet back one at a time and lift your knees.

forearm-plank__cue-9.text: Lower your knees, and rest back in Child’s Pose.

side-plank__cue-1.text: From Plank, roll onto the outer edge of your right foot.

side-plank__cue-9.text: Exhale, come back to Plank, and take the other side.

low-lunge__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, step your right foot forward between your hands.

low-lunge__cue-2.text: Lower your left knee, and rest the top of your back foot on the mat.

low-lunge__cue-9.text: Bring your hands down, tuck your back toes, and step back to Downward Dog.

crescent-lunge__cue-2.text: Inhale, rise up, and reach your arms overhead.

crescent-lunge__cue-9.text: Exhale, hands down to the mat, and step back to Downward Dog.

reverse-warrior__cue-1.text: From Warrior Two, turn your front palm up.

reverse-warrior__cue-9.text: Exhale, and cartwheel your hands down to frame your front foot.

humble-warrior__cue-1.text: From Warrior One, interlace your hands behind your back.

humble-warrior__cue-9.text: Inhale, rise back up slowly, and release your hands.

goddess-pose__cue-1.text: Step your feet wide, and turn your toes out.

goddess-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, straighten your legs, and slowly walk your feet back together.

side-bend__cue-1.text: Stand with your feet together, or hip-width apart.

side-bend__cue-9.text: Inhale back to centre, and change sides.

tree-pose__cue-1.text: Stand tall, and shift your weight into your left foot.

tree-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your foot, and change sides.

eagle-pose__cue-1.text: Bend your knees and sink your hips, as if you’re sitting into a chair.

eagle-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, unwind your arms and legs, and change sides.

warrior-3__cue-1.text: From Crescent Lunge, shift your weight into your front foot.

warrior-3__cue-9.text: Exhale, bend your standing knee, and step back into your lunge.

half-moon__cue-1.text: From Warrior Two, reach your front hand to a block, a little ahead of your front foot.

half-moon__cue-9.text: Exhale, bend your standing knee, and step back into Warrior Two.

dancer-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, slowly lower your foot, and change sides.

crow-pose__cue-1.text: From a squat, plant your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers spread wide.

crow-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your feet, and come back to your squat.

dolphin-pose__cue-3.text: Tuck your toes, and lift your hips up and back.

dolphin-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower your knees, and rest in Child’s Pose.

handstand__cue-1.text: Place your hands shoulder-width apart, about a hand’s length from the wall.

handstand__cue-3.text: Step one foot in, and kick up gently with the other leg.

handstand__cue-9.text: Exhale, come down one leg at a time, and rest in Child’s Pose.

cobra__cue-1.text: Lie on your belly, and place your hands under your shoulders.

cobra__cue-9.text: Exhale, and lower your chest down to the mat.

locust-pose__cue-1.text: Lie on your belly, arms by your sides, palms facing down.

locust-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, lower down, and rest with your head turned to one side.

bow-pose__cue-1.text: Lying on your belly, bend your knees and reach back for your ankles.

bow-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, slowly let go of your ankles, and rest on your belly.

camel-pose__cue-1.text: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart, hips stacked over your knees.

camel-pose__cue-9.text: Bring your hands to your lower back, and inhale up, chest first.

bridge-pose__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, bend your knees, and place your feet hip-width apart.

bridge-pose__cue-9.text: Exhale, release your hands, and roll down one bone at a time.

wild-thing__cue-1.text: Come into Side Plank on your right hand.

wild-thing__cue-9.text: Exhale, flip back over to Downward Dog, and take the other side.

lizard-pose__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, step your right foot to the outside of your right hand.

lizard-pose__cue-9.text: Press back up, step back to Downward Dog, and change sides.

half-splits__cue-1.text: From Low Lunge, shift your hips back over your back knee.

half-splits__cue-9.text: Inhale, bend your front knee, and come back into Low Lunge.

pigeon__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, bring your right knee forward, behind your right wrist.

pigeon__cue-9.text: Press into your hands, tuck your back toes, and step back to Downward Dog.

malasana__cue-1.text: Step your feet a little wider than your hips, toes turned out.

malasana__cue-9.text: Bring your hands down, lift your hips, and fold forward.

figure-four__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, with your knees bent and your feet on the mat.

figure-four__cue-9.text: Release your hands, uncross your legs, and change sides.

happy-baby__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, and hug your knees toward your chest.

happy-baby__cue-9.text: Release your feet, and rest them back on the mat.

reclined-bound-angle__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, and bring the soles of your feet together.

reclined-bound-angle__cue-8.text: Use your hands to bring your knees together, and roll onto your side.

hero-pose__cue-1.text: Kneel with your knees together, and your feet a little wider than your hips.

hero-pose__cue-2.text: Roll your calves out with your hands, and sit down between your heels.

hero-pose__cue-9.text: Lean forward onto your hands, and lift up off your heels.

reclined-hero__cue-1.text: Start sitting between your heels, with your knees together.

reclined-hero__cue-2.text: Lean back onto your hands, then slowly down onto your forearms.

reclined-hero__cue-9.text: Press into your forearms, then your hands, and come up slowly.

gate-pose__cue-1.text: Kneel, and stretch your right leg out to the side.

gate-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, come back up, and change sides.

cow-face-pose__cue-1.text: Sit, and cross your right knee over your left, stacking your knees.

cow-face-pose__cue-9.text: Release your arms, uncross your legs, and change sides.

thread-the-needle__cue-1.text: Start on all fours, wrists under your shoulders.

thread-the-needle__cue-9.text: Press into your left hand, unwind, and change sides.

seated-twist__cue-1.text: Sit with your legs straight, then step your right foot outside your left thigh.

seated-twist__cue-9.text: Inhale, unwind back to centre, and change sides.

supine-twist__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, and hug your right knee into your chest.

supine-twist__cue-9.text: Inhale, roll back to centre, and change sides.

swan__cue-1.text: From all fours, bring your right knee forward, behind your right wrist.

swan__cue-8.text: To come out, tuck your back toes and slowly press back to all fours.

shoelace__cue-1.text: Sit on the edge of a folded blanket, and bring your left heel beside your right hip.

shoelace__cue-3.text: Slowly fold forward, and let your back round.

shoelace__cue-8.text: Use your hands to roll up slowly, and gently uncross your legs.

square__cue-1.text: Sit on a folded blanket, with your left shin parallel to the front of your mat.

square__cue-8.text: Use your hands to roll up slowly, then unstack your legs.

dragon__cue-1.text: From all fours, step your right foot forward between your hands.

dragon__cue-8.text: To come out, walk your hands back under your shoulders, and step back to all fours.

frog__cue-1.text: Come onto all fours, with a blanket under your knees.

frog__cue-3.text: Lower onto your forearms, or rest your chest on a bolster.

frog__cue-8.text: To come out, slide forward onto your belly, then slowly draw your knees in.

butterfly__cue-1.text: Sit on a folded blanket, and bring the soles of your feet together.

butterfly__cue-4.text: Fold forward slowly, and let your back round. Your head can hang.

butterfly__cue-8.text: To come out, roll up slowly, with your head coming up last.

half-butterfly__cue-1.text: Sit on a blanket with your right leg straight, and your left foot against your inner right thigh.

half-butterfly__cue-3.text: Fold forward over your straight leg, or toward the middle. Let your back round.

half-butterfly__cue-8.text: Slowly roll up, with your head coming up last.

dragonfly__cue-1.text: Sit on the edge of a folded blanket, and open your legs wide.

dragonfly__cue-3.text: Fold forward slowly. Rest on your hands, your forearms or a bolster.

dragonfly__cue-8.text: Use your hands to roll up slowly, then bring your legs together.

deer__cue-1.text: Sit with your knees bent and your feet wide, then let both knees fall to the right.

deer__cue-8.text: Slowly come upright, and bring your knees back to the middle.

cat-pulling-its-tail__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, and let your knees fall to the left into a twist.

cat-pulling-its-tail__cue-3.text: Bend your left knee, and draw your left foot back behind you.

cat-pulling-its-tail__cue-8.text: Slowly release your foot, and roll onto your back.

caterpillar__cue-1.text: Sit on a folded blanket, with your legs straight out in front of you.

caterpillar__cue-3.text: Fold forward, and let your back round like a caterpillar.

caterpillar__cue-8.text: Slowly roll up, one vertebra at a time.

snail__cue-1.text: Lie on your back, with a folded blanket under your shoulders and your head on the mat.

snail__cue-2.text: Bend your knees, and slowly roll your hips up and over.

snail__cue-7.text: To come out, bend your knees, and roll down slowly, one vertebra at a time.

sphinx__cue-1.text: Lie on your belly, and come up onto your forearms.

revolved-triangle__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up, and turn to the left.

extended-side-angle__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up, and turn to the left.

revolved-side-angle__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up, and turn to the left.

pyramid-pose__cue-9.text: Inhale, come up, and turn to the left.

crescent-lunge__cue-1.text: From Downward Dog, step your right foot forward between your hands.

dancer-pose__cue-1.text: Stand tall, and shift your weight into your left foot.

dolphin-pose__cue-1.text: From all fours, lower onto your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
